beats.say: Australia is almost as big as the mainland United States.
beats.title: AUSTRALIA IS HUGE (AND EMPTY)

beats.say: Drop it on top of America at true size.
Almost a perfect fit. But the USA has about three hundred forty million people. Australia has around twenty seven million.
And most Australians live right on the edge. About eighty five percent live within fifty kilometers of the coast.
The middle is the outback: desert, scrubland and red dirt, as far as you can see.
A whole continent, living on the beach. Follow for more.
beats.title: A CONTINENT ON THE BEACH
